positions.title: Technical Integration Specialist
positions.description:
-Developed new features across a suite of enterprise software tools that allow large global retailers to create and publish product signs, using HTML, VB/JavaScript, C#, DevExpress, XML, and SQL stored procedure.
-Built customized client applications for both on-premise and SaaS environment.

positions.title: Sr. Application Developer
positions.description:
-Integrated, developed, tested, deployed, maintained, and documented highly customized applications that execute the core functionality of AccessVia retail publishing technologies, in both on-premise and SaaS environment, according to client business requirements. 
-Worked with clients for product demonstrations, gathering business requirements, and providing solutions that met their needs.
-Installed and configured client applications, both on-site and remotely. Provided training on our software. Assisted clients with upgrade and patch deployment. Clients included Walgreens, OfficeMax, SuperValu, Publix, Big 5, Best Buy, Wegmans, Fresh Market, Safeway, Camping World, Kohls, Staples Canada, and Loblaw Canada.
-Tested, debugged, diagnosed issues, and modified code in existing applications to correct malfunctions and improve functionality and performance.
-Developed and maintained SDK products, lead SDK client integration projects.
-Developed applications for sales demo and tradeshows, including digital signage, electronic shelf label publishing applications.
-Built SQL reports for publishing activity data analysis.
-Wrote scripts for automated data transfer jobs for SaaS clients.
-Assisted support engineers with higher level support cases that required debugging Web and WinForm applications.
-Exercised standard database normalization practices in the definition of database structures.  Defined and modified database schemas.
-Functioned as a liaison between application services and development teams, in an Agile development environment.
-Collaborated with the Quality Assurance team to prioritize and fix outstanding software defects.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
-Tested Internet Explorer security patches.
-Set up and configured various operating systems for software testing
-Filed and investigated bugs.
-Created, executed and maintained manual and automation test cases.
-Repaired and developed test scripts.
-Maintained test plans, tracked issues.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
-Designed, developed and implemented database solutions using Access and SQL server, customized inter- and intra-departmental reports with Access, Crystal Reports, and web-based SQL Reporting Services to support manufacturing, distribution and financial departments 
-Developed, tested, deployed and maintained software applications, components, win/web clients and database services
-Developed, tested and debugged Visibar programs. Maintained and supported data collection, automated transaction systems, and reconciliation processes related to the ERP system
-Created documentation for developed applications, automated processes, databases, and user procedures
-Supported Database Administrator with database/ERP projects, training and issue resolution as well as system maintenance and upgrade
